description: Na₃Bi(BO₃)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.48 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.37 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.39 Å) and one longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond length. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.38-1.40 Å. Bi is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.68 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one B, and one Bi atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one B, and one Bi atom.
